bio.text: Andrew Lanza, a Republican, has represented New York State Senate District 24 since 2007.
He is on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot for re-election, as a Republican and Conservative Party candidate.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a B.S. in accounting from Saint John's University and a J.D. from Fordham University School of Law in 1992.
According to Ballotpedia, his professional experience includes serving on the New York City Council and working as an Assistant District Attorney for Robert Morgenthau.
